# Rieke OS / EpicTreeGUI

> Local Symphony recording workspace and MATLAB epoch browser.

Availability: the public master branch currently contains the legacy MATLAB app.
The complete Rieke OS development source is on the codex/rieke-native-e2e review
branch. Obtain it with:

git clone --branch codex/rieke-native-e2e https://github.com/maxwellsdm1867/epicTreeGUI.git

Verify rieke.py and the complete application before installing. There is no
signed standalone desktop installer, stable app release or published Rieke OS
pip package specified by this repository.

- [Overview and download status](README.md)
- [Setup, launch, storage and troubleshooting](docs/RIEKE_OS_QUICK_START.md)
- [Copyable LLM setup prompt](docs/LLM_SETUP.md)
- [Runtime and export reference](workspace-app/README.md)
- [MATLAB user guide](docs/UserGuide.md)

Use the documented clone-local setup; preserve dependency pins and project data.
Distinguish app readiness, bundled native MySQL readiness and observed
browser/project success. New native projects do not require Docker or an external
MySQL installation. Legacy Docker projects require explicit migration. Do not
claim fresh-install validation unless it was actually performed.
